land_per_acre.label: Land price per acre
land_per_acre.assumption: The 2026 asking-price level per acre for Highway Corridor land at the I-20 and FM 148 interchange, deliberately not cited so that no real parcel is identified. It sits far above the Exit 509 tract that sold in March 2026 after listing at $1,300,000 for 16.63 acres [^23]; an appraisal and a contract set the value.

acres_used.label: Acres the sponsor buys
acres_used.assumption: About 12 acres in the Highway Corridor district at the interchange. A comparable chain build, Love's in Rock Falls, Illinois, used about 14 acres of a 30-acre site for more truck parking than this program [^40].

site_work.label: Site work: grading, heavy-duty truck court, stormwater, lighting
site_work.assumption: Concrete and asphalt for about 80 truck spaces, fuel islands and car parking on about 12 acres, with detention. No published per-space or per-acre travel-center cost was found.

building_sf.label: Building, square feet (store, food court, showers, laundry, lounge)
building_sf.assumption: A store, food court, showers, laundry and driver lounge, smaller than the 11,365 square foot North Chicago travel center approved in February 2026 [^41].

building_psf.label: Building cost per square foot
building_psf.assumption: A travel-center shell with kitchen, showers and laundry, in a year when nonresidential construction inputs rose 8.9% [^45].

fuel_system.label: Fuel system: five diesel lanes, six gasoline dispensers, tanks, canopies, DEF
fuel_system.assumption: Two canopies, four underground tanks, high-flow diesel dispensers with satellites and bulk DEF, and a six-dispenser car island.

ffe.label: Equipment: truck scale, kitchen, coolers, shower fixtures, point of sale
ffe.assumption: A certified truck scale, food-court kitchen, walk-in coolers, shower and laundry fixtures and point-of-sale systems.

soft.label: Design, traffic study, Specific Use Permit, Phase I, legal, appraisal
soft.assumption: Engineering and architecture, a traffic study for the Specific Use Permit hearing [^1], a Phase I environmental site assessment, legal, appraisal and the feasibility study.

contingency_pct.label: Hard-cost contingency
contingency_pct.assumption: 8% of site, building and fuel system costs; the diesel that drives site-work bids rose 77.8% in producer prices in a year [^53].

construction_interest.label: Interest during construction
construction_interest.assumption: Interest on the interim loan over a build of about a year after the permit.

working_capital.label: Opening fuel and store inventory, pre-opening payroll
working_capital.assumption: Tank fills for five diesel lanes and the car island, opening merchandise and food, and hiring and training.

diesel_gal.label: Diesel gallons sold
diesel_gal.assumption: Year 1 matches the 2.6 million diesel gallons an independent truck stop reported in a September 2025 sale listing [^54]. Rises to about 2,100 gallons per lane per day across five lanes by Year 3 as the Airport Road and US 80 logistics projects open [^27,30]. No truck share of I-20 traffic was found.

diesel_margin.label: Diesel gross margin per gallon
diesel_margin.assumption: Between the 35 to 40 cent five-year average fuel markup NACS reports [^46] and the 2025 average of over 40 cents [^62]; fleet-card discounts keep a truck stop's realized diesel margin below its posted spread.

gas_gal.label: Gasoline gallons sold
gas_gal.assumption: Modest, because Buc-ee's at the same exit takes the car traffic [^10,11]; Year 1 matches the 0.8 million gasoline gallons in the same September 2025 listing [^54].

inside_sales.label: Inside sales: store, food court, beverages
inside_sales.assumption: Year 1 near the $2.5 million of inside sales in the September 2025 listing [^54], rising with diesel customers and the food court.

inside_margin.label: Inside gross margin, blended
inside_margin.assumption: Yesway's 35.2% merchandise margin [^48] on most of the store and the 56.41% average prepared-food margin NACS reported for 2024 [^49] on the food share.

services.label: Reserved parking, showers, scale and laundry
services.assumption: Paid reserved spaces, shower and laundry fees and scale weighs. TA Terrell already sells reserved parking [^8]; no local price for any of these services was found.

staff_hours.label: Paid hourly staff hours per year
staff_hours.assumption: About 26 full-time equivalents across store, food court, fuel desk and housekeeping, open 24 hours.

burden.label: Payroll taxes and workers' compensation
burden.assumption: Employer taxes and workers' compensation on hourly wages.

cost_growth.label: Annual wage and cost growth
cost_growth.assumption: 3% a year, below the 5.0% rise in construction-trade hourly earnings AGC reported for the year to August 2026 [^45].

management.label: General manager and assistant manager
management.assumption: Two salaried managers for a 24-hour site; charged whether or not the owner works there.

card_fee.label: Card and fleet-card processing cost per gallon

taxable_value.label: Appraised value for property tax
taxable_value.assumption: Below cost, because special-purpose improvements rarely appraise at cost. For scale, Kaufman CAD carried Buc-ee's, a much larger store at the same exit, at $15,909,580 in 2020 [^13].

other_opex.label: Insurance, utilities, repairs, scale certification, environmental, supplies
other_opex.assumption: Property and liability insurance on a 24-hour fuel site, power for the store and lot lighting, hot water for showers, repairs, tank testing and supplies.

tpl_rate.label: Bank first-lien rate
tpl_rate.assumption: Prime from the H.15 release [^58] plus 1.25 points for a special-purpose start-up; no published 2026 lender terms for travel centers were found, the 10-year Treasury sat near 5% in September 2026 [^60], and the bank sets the rate at pricing

tpl_amort_years.label: Bank loan amortization
tpl_amort_years.assumption: 25 years, matching the debenture; the bank may require a shorter term.

debenture_years.label: Debenture term
debenture_years.assumption: The 25-year debenture available when real estate is the larger share of the project [^56].
